name: HSSV Pet Pantry
description: Free pet food for Santa Clara County residents experiencing financial hardship; pick up every 30 days
fullDescription: The Humane Society Silicon Valley's Pet Pantry program helps families keep their pets by providing free pet food during times of financial hardship.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free dog and cat food (set amount based on your initial application)
- Pick up every 30 days
- Short-term safety net, not meant to be a pet's only food source
- Food depends on donations and availability
- Cat colony caretakers are not served
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a Santa Clara County resident experiencing financial hardship
2. Visit the Pet Pantry Warehouse in person to sign up (1116 Wrigley Way, Milpitas)
3. Go Thursday-Sunday, 12:00-3:30 pm
4. Bring a photo ID each time you pick up food
5. Return every 30 days as needed
6. Questions? Call ext. 110 or email petpantry@hssv.org
keywords: HSSV, Humane Society Silicon Valley, pet food, free pet food, pet pantry, dog food, cat food, Milpitas, Santa Clara, keep pet
